protocol.section: 6. RQ3：零标签迁移与适配分解

x_transform: x = logit(clip(boltz2_iptm, 1e-6, 1-1e-6)); the same clip is used only for log loss and calibration logit, while Brier uses the unclipped predicted probability
reliability_bin_rule: np.digitize(p, edges[1:-1], right=False); report every bin including empty bins

source_models.estimator: unpenalized weighted maximum likelihood logistic regression implemented with existing numpy/scipy; no dependency installation
source_models.linear_design: one intercept indicator per source target with no global intercept, plus one common x slope
source_models.fit_rows: split_status == train only, after the frozen cross-target-cluster exclusions
source_models.convergence: stable logaddexp likelihood and analytic gradient; L-BFGS-B with multiple deterministic starts if needed; maxiter>=1000, ftol<=1e-12, gtol<=1e-8
source_models.parameter_bounds: all linear predictor coefficients bounded to [-40,40] solely as a numerical failure guard; hitting a bound is a QC failure, not an estimable result
source_models.failure_rule: record nonconvergence, singular/unidentifiable information, nonfinite values, or bound-hitting as unevaluable; do not silently add ridge, drop targets, change weights, or use test labels
source_models.target_equal_transport_intercept: unweighted arithmetic mean of the fitted source-target intercepts
source_models.pair_transport_intercept: sum(n_j*alpha_j)/sum(n_j), where n_j is the post-exclusion training pair count for source target j
source_models.common_slope_transport: the fitted common slope is transferred unchanged
source_models.transport_prediction: p_U = expit(alpha_bar + beta_common*x_test), or the corresponding common RCS basis coefficients for spline sensitivity

restricted_cubic_spline.knot_estimation_rows: current LOTO source training rows only, after cross-target exclusions; never the held-out target
restricted_cubic_spline.weighted_quantile: sort x ascending with the current source weights; c=(cumsum(w)-0.5*w)/sum(w); np.interp(q,c,x,left=min(x),right=max(x)); target_equal uses weight_target_equal_raw, pair uses weight_pair
restricted_cubic_spline.design: source-target intercept indicators plus common B1 and B2 coefficients
restricted_cubic_spline.test_transform: reuse the training knots and formula unchanged; do not recompute knots or truncate test x to the training range
restricted_cubic_spline.tie_or_convergence_rule: if knots are not strictly increasing or fit fails QC, mark the spline fold unevaluable; do not alter quantiles or substitute another spline
restricted_cubic_spline.unit_test_required: verify B2 and its first and second derivatives are zero below k1, and the second derivative is zero above k3; verify linear extrapolation beyond outer knots

bss_references.transport_target_equal: constant p = unweighted mean of the post-exclusion source-target prevalences
bss_references.transport_pair: constant p = total post-exclusion source positives / total post-exclusion source pairs
bss_references.target_oracle: constant p = actual held-out-target prevalence; diagnostic only, never a deployable zero-label reference
bss_references.adaptation_train: for predictive I/F, constant p = current outer adaptation-training prevalence, evaluated on the corresponding outer test rows
bss_references.formula: BSS = 1 - mean((p_model-y)^2)/mean((p_reference-y)^2); preserve the reference predictions row by row

metrics.calibration_diagnostic: unpenalized logistic y ~ intercept + slope*logit(clip(predicted_probability)); fitted only for evaluation after predictions are fixed; do not call it training
metrics.macro_summary: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-held-out-target metrics; also report target count, signs, min and max; no pooling hidden inside macro Brier or BSS
metrics.pair_summary: pool row-level predictions across held-out targets and compute pair-weighted metrics; keep this separate from macro results
metrics.reliability: per held-out target and model layer using frozen common bins; report n, positives, mean prediction, observed rate and Wilson 95% interval
metrics.bootstrap: not required in this execution; do not claim population uncertainty over future targets from six targets

oracle_and_descriptive_layers.oracle_I: for each LOTO target, use all target labels only after U is fixed; solve a so mean(expit(a+eta_U)) equals full-target prevalence; label oracle_base_rate_scenario and never zero-label
oracle_and_descriptive_layers.descriptive_F: for each LOTO target, fit unpenalized eta_F=a+gamma*eta_U on all target rows after U is fixed; label descriptive_in_sample_adaptation, never predictive improvement
oracle_and_descriptive_layers.scope: linear U only, both source weighting schemes and all analysis-set/cluster-rule combinations
oracle_and_descriptive_layers.metrics: report Brier, log loss, BSS-target-oracle and calibration diagnostics; descriptive F is not required to improve Brier

predictive_adaptation.scope: linear U only, both source weighting schemes and all analysis-set/cluster-rule combinations
predictive_adaptation.base_prediction: eta_U is fixed from the corresponding LOTO source model before target-internal adaptation; never refit the source model using target adaptation labels
predictive_adaptation.I_model: eta_I=a+eta_U; fit only intercept a on each outer adaptation-training set by weighted-free maximum likelihood/root solving; all adaptation pairs have equal weight
predictive_adaptation.F_penalty: minimize mean negative log-likelihood on the adaptation-training rows + 0.5*lambda*delta^2; intercept a is unpenalized and delta=0 corresponds exactly to unchanged U slope
predictive_adaptation.adaptation_training_weight: 1 per pair for both source-weighting variants; source weighting affects only the fixed U base model
predictive_adaptation.lambda_selection: for each lambda, fit F on every inner-training split and concatenate all inner-validation predictions; choose the lambda with minimum pooled inner-validation log loss using probability_clip; if values tie within 1e-12, choose the larger lambda; Brier is not the selection metric
predictive_adaptation.final_outer_fit: refit a and delta with selected lambda on the full outer adaptation-training set and predict its untouched outer test split
predictive_adaptation.failure_rule: if inner folds cannot be formed, an inner-training set has one class, a candidate fails QC, or the final fit fails, record the affected lambda/fold as unevaluable; if all lambdas fail, predictive F is unevaluable; never use outer test labels to repair or select
predictive_adaptation.required_comparisons: on identical outer-test rows compare U, predictive I and predictive F; include Brier, log loss, BSS-adaptation-train, BSS-target-oracle and the same target's original BSS-transport
predictive_adaptation.aggregation: save outer-fold metrics and concatenate each target's five outer-test prediction sets for target-level out-of-fold metrics; adaptation-train baselines remain fold-specific row by row

required_outputs: complete scripts commands logs and failed-item ledger

figure_requirements.primary_story: U-layer held-out-target Brier and both BSS values, with log loss and reliability support; distinguish target-equal macro from pair summaries
figure_requirements.adaptation_story: U, predictive I and predictive F on identical outer-test rows; oracle I and descriptive F visually or textually separated as nondeployable diagnostics
figure_requirements.aah_i: must remain visible as a separate target; five-target sensitivity must not be hidden
